Maya R: AM standup — quick pipeline note: handed off Kestrel pilot to infra yesterday; sales demo Thurs 11am PT. What I did: got Dedicated pricing sketch to legal, validated KMS BYOK flow with eng-priv. Blockers: need exact HSM keywrap confirmation from infra (Raj), and a short note from security on export control docs. Today: finalize playbook for pilot onboarding, ping eng-platform for the canary.

Lucas H: thanks — can you paste the KMS flow doc? also tagging @Raj P for HSM wrap.

Maya R: pasted link: https://redwood.internal/drive/pilots/kestrel-kms (internal) — main step is `wrapKey()` in the onboarding script.

Raj P: saw it, will confirm HSM vendor compatibility today. current blocker is vendor cert matrix — expect to have note by 4pm PT.

Sophia T: heads-up: customer asked about latency SLOs. For Dedicated pilot we promised 95th <= 120ms on nv4x. We should include fallback to smaller model variant in playbook.

Maya R: good call — I'll add `fallback_model: redwood/mini-1b` section.

Kevin L: PR #4286 is up for the onboarding CLI change (minor): `--byok-key-id` flag and docs. can someone review? @Sophia T or @Lucas H?

Lucas H: I'll take a look after standup. quick note: run `make local-onboard` then `./bin/onboard --simulate` to test.

Sophia T: reviewing now. small nit in README about env var `REDWOOD_KMS_REGION`. will comment on PR.

Maya R: thanks — Raj, ping me when HSM cert is confirmed so I can update legal. Also scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT with sales + infra to walk through playbook.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary for `kestrel-pilot` scheduled at 2026-03-18T18:00Z :rocket:

Raj P: HSM vendor confirms AES-KEK wrap supported; sending cert matrix to Maya and legal now.

Maya R: awesome, thx. closing blocker. :thumbsup:
